excerpt.zh: 我们的一艘方舟舰陷入黑暗无助漂流，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
excerpt.en: One of our Arkships lies dark and adrift, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.
